long_notes:
Hi guys! This update adds the amazing new models Grok 4.6 and Imagine 2.0!

Grok 4.6 is SpaceXAI’s new flagship model that is made for longer agentic work, and it includes a new Extra High reasoning effort setting. And Imagine 2.0 is SpaceXAI’s latest image generation and editing model, which is much better at sticking to your prompts and adding text and stuff like that. I hope you all enjoy!

Oh, and there are also some future announcements I would like to make. There are many xAI Imagine features that I have not been able to add to Grok AI Chat because of it’s large size and focus on chatting, like reference images, video extension, quality, stuff like that. So I am officially announcing that I plan to take all of the Image, Video, and Audio Generation elements out of Grok AI Chat and put them into their own dedicated shortcut, which will be named Grok Imagine! I can’t really say exactly when it will be released, but hopefully soon.

I also plan to soon add the ability to use custom MCP tools in Grok AI Chat, reasoning effort controls to Grok AI Nano, and several updates to Grok Code as well. I am very excited about these features, and I hope you all will enjoy them as well! Thank you and God bless you!
